summary.text: Bangladesh U19 won by 45 runs. BANU19 made 245-10, Ahsan Al Mumin top-scoring with 82 off 98 balls; Sethmika Seneviratne took 4 for 52. SLU19 made 200-10, Senuja Wekunagoda top-scoring with 85 off 95 balls; Sheikh Atiqur Rahman took 2 for 28.
